note: The Office of the Australian Information Commissioner: a payment is missed if made more than 14 days after its due date, written as reported on the 15th day; repayment history stays on a credit report two years. The credit reporting bodies it names for a report are Equifax and Experian. A default (60 days, $150 and two notices) is a further listing, not modeled.

sources.title: OAIC, Repayment history and defaults
sources.said: This information remains on your credit report for 2 years. ... You are considered to have missed a payment if you make the payment more than 14 days after the due date.

sources.title: OAIC, Access your credit report
sources.said: You can request a copy of your credit report from these credit reporting bodies: Equifax , phone 138 332 Experian , phone 1300 783 684
